description: Engine and whichpart-api code and configuration in one change set (proof of concept, no real customers): the Opus-only cleanup of ADR 0023 (code changes 23.3 engine, 23.4 BFF). Engine: inference.js is the Anthropic provider only; admin-config.js reads the advisor model and key and no Jev secret; jev-client.js, ac2/errorcodes.js and ac2/data deleted; JEV_SECRET_ID and LM_STUDIO_URL removed. whichpart-api: the benchmark envelope, qwen-plain control, image hand-off, transcript review job and Test area routes removed; unmatched /admin paths are 404; Settings edit the advisor model and its write-only credential only; the 15-minute transcript-review schedule is acknowledged with no work; ACQ_JUDGE_MODEL, JEV_SECRET_ID, TRANSCRIPT_REVIEW_ENABLED, TRANSCRIPT_REVIEW_MAX_PER_RUN, TRANSCRIPT_REVIEW_MODEL, TRANSCRIPT_REVIEW_PROVIDER and LM_STUDIO_URL removed. All removed variables were unread by the code. Previous code: phase8/applianceclinic-diagnosis-engine-2lF7irHC2jwr-QurXitQwJUlVKCa3_rbhqqE1pPOfRU.zip and phase8/whichpart-api-yVnW1nTw1upmNyUR7SNGb9GcQoGqXgWLbzQSri_Yc9w.zip; rollback = restore both s3Keys and the removed variables.
classification: SAFE AC CHANGE (code and configuration of the AC diagnosis engine and whichpart-api)
